scope: Original base game standard core + applicable linked Living FAQ; optional modules excluded

questions.question: Concealing Shadows has resolved on a land. Later that turn, Poisoned Land resolves there and instructs the Spirit to destroy all Dahan. Does Concealing Shadows prevent those destructions? If Infinite Vitality's threshold had also resolved on that land this turn, would that threshold prevent them?

A Spirit Power directly and explicitly deals 2 Damage to Dahan; it does not cause a Ravage. Would Defend 3 reduce this Damage? Would Concealing Shadows prevent it? Would Infinite Vitality’s threshold prevent it? Separately, if Invaders Ravage for 2 Damage in a land with Defend 3, how much reaches the land and Dahan?

Spirit A has an existing +2 bonus to its Power Ranges and uses Reaching Grasp, whose text grants target Spirit B +2 Range with all their Powers. Does A’s existing bonus increase the amount granted to +4, or does B receive +2? Does B’s Power-only bonus cover Innate Powers as well as Power Cards, and can it extend ordinary Growth placement?

For a Range arrow within a Power’s effect text, where is the origin for a land-targeting Power? Where is it for a Spirit-targeting Power used by Spirit A that instructs Spirit B to act? Which Spirit’s Range bonuses apply, and if that internal arrow is Range 1 with A having +2 and B having no bonus, what Range can it reach from whose Presence? How does Blazing Renewal’s explicit measurement origin differ?

A Spirit plays and pays for a Power Card, then foregoes its entire text because it has no legal target or the Spirit chooses not to use it. With no other effect removing the card, do its printed Elements remain available for Innates, is its Energy refunded, and does the card leave play immediately or during Time Passes?

Two separate Ravages occur in the same land before Time Passes. Each would deal 4 Damage before the land’s Defend 3; assume that pre-Defend total stays 4, and one Dahan starts healthy. Is Defend expended on the first Ravage? How much Damage reaches land and Dahan each time? Do the two 1-Damage land results combine into Blight, and what happens to that Dahan on the second Ravage?

A Power has a lower threshold requiring 2 Water and a higher threshold requiring 3 Water. Its Spirit has 3 Water. May the Spirit resolve that Power as if it had only 2 Water, getting the lower threshold but not the higher one? May another Power still check the Spirit's actual 3 Water later this turn? Assume no instruction gains or loses Elements.

A Spirit has several separate Growth options and no instruction allowing more than one choice. During one Spirit Phase, may it combine the Energy action from one option with the Add Presence action from a different option, or must it choose a single entire option?

An ordinary land-targeting Power has printed Range 1, Target ANY and no special origin requirement. Your Presence is in land A, and land B is adjacent to A. Assuming all other restrictions are met, may you target A as well as B, or must the target be exactly one land away from your Presence?

Spirit A uses Powerstorm on Bringer of Dreams and Nightmares. Afterwards Bringer uses Call on Midnight’s Dream in a legal land with Dahan, gains a Fast Major Power, Forgets Call on Midnight’s Dream for the Major gain, and uses its conditional permission to play the new Major immediately. Bringer then uses that new Major normally. Assume sufficient Energy, valid targets, and no other restrictions. May Bringer spend the previously granted Powerstorm Repeat on this new Major even though it was not in play when Powerstorm resolved?

In a standard core game a land is already crowded with Invaders, Dahan, and Spirit Presence. Can a general per-land stacking limit prevent an otherwise legal Build, Gather, or Presence placement there? Do any of those three types of piece have such a default cap?

Bringer uses Call on Midnight’s Dream in a legal target land containing both Dahan and Invaders. May Bringer first draw and inspect the four Major Power Cards from the first option, then decide to take the other option’s 2 Fear instead, or must the ~or~ option be chosen before either option begins resolving?

What is the required order of an individual Spirit's Growth, normal track Energy gain, and actual playing/paying for Power Cards? May the Spirit take its normal Energy income before finishing Growth or actually play/pay before Growth? If Growth uncovers a higher Energy number, is that number used for normal income in this same Spirit Phase?

A Spirit still has Presence disks on its Presence tracks. When resolving an ordinary Add Presence instruction, may it choose to reposition one of its Presence already on the island instead of taking a track disk, or is repositioning permitted only after its tracks are empty?

Dread Apparitions has already resolved in a land. A normal Spirit Power there generates 1 printed Fear and destroys one Town, generating another 1 Fear. Which of those Fear sources count for Dread Apparitions, and counting only this later Power’s Fear, how much additional Defend does it add? Separately, Bringer’s Power there generates exactly 2 Fear from To Dream a Thousand Deaths pretend-destroying a Town and no other Fear. Does that Fear count, and how much additional Defend is added?

Ocean uses Tidal Boon on another Spirit, and that Spirit uses this Power’s Push to send a Dahan into Ocean’s active Ocean. May Ocean instead move that Dahan to a nonadjacent Coastal land rather than Drowning it? Who chooses, and is taking that alternative mandatory?

Wrap in Wings of Sunlight meets its threshold. Its target land initially has no Dahan, but Dahan are available in adjacent lands. Does its threshold’s “First, Gather up to 3 Dahan” happen before the base Move, so those Dahan can then be moved and the destination Defended, or must the base Move finish first because it is printed higher? Likewise, with Dissolve the Bonds of Kinship’s threshold, does its Invader-on-Invader Damage happen before or after Pushing the Explorers?

List the five phases of an ordinary turn in order. If one Spirit has finished playing and paying while another is still choosing Growth, may the first begin resolving a Fast Power? Within the Fast Power Phase, must Powers follow player order, or may players choose their sequence?
After a Spirit has followed its back-panel island setup, where are its remaining Presence disks put? Are the leftmost solid-circle Energy and Card Plays numbers covered?
